title: Colored Shulkers
description: Adds variety to Shulkers by making them in different colors. Naming a Shulker Jeb, will make it act like a Jeb Sheep!
body:
Hi everyone!

For those of you that wanted a bit of variety with Minecraft, I bring you random Colored Shulkers! Also, naming 1 jeb_ makes it change colors like the jeb_ sheep!

No resourcepack needed! Cool little feature to add to your World/Server!
